name: voiden-contextual-org-picker
description: Voiden plugin: choose a Contextual organization per environment and fill in x-org-id.

scripts.zip: pnpm run build && rm -rf dist/stage dist/contextual-org-picker.zip && mkdir -p dist/stage && cp manifest.json dist/build/contextual-org-picker.js dist/stage/ && cd dist/stage && zip -q -X ../contextual-org-picker.zip manifest.json contextual-org-picker.js && cd .. && rm -rf stage && echo "Built dist/contextual-org-picker.zip"
